curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: value the need for the right posture while reading.

interactions.prompt: Which learner is ready to read?
choices: sitting upright with the book in front
holding the book behind the back
interactions.answer: sitting upright with the book in front
interactions.feedback: Yes! An upright body and a well-placed book help us read comfortably.
interactions.retryHint: Look for a straight, relaxed back and a book the eyes can see.

interactions.prompt: Put the reading-ready steps in order.
interactions.feedback: Great! Prepare your body and book before reading.
interactions.retryHint: First prepare your body, then the book, then your eyes.

interactions.prompt: Match each good reading habit to its benefit.
interactions.feedback: Well matched! Good posture makes reading safer and easier.
interactions.retryHint: Think about what each body or book position helps you do.

interactions.prompt: Your neck hurts while reading. What should you change?
choices: sit upright and raise the book comfortably
interactions.answer: sit upright and raise the book comfortably
interactions.feedback: Correct! A comfortable upright position cares for your body.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the change that removes the deep bend in your neck.

interactions.prompt: You are reading on a mat. Which choice still shows good posture?
choices: sit steadily with a straight relaxed back and book in front
place the book under one knee
interactions.answer: sit steadily with a straight relaxed back and book in front
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Good reading posture works in different places.
interactions.retryHint: Find the position that keeps both body and book steady.

interactions.prompt: Why do we use the right posture while reading?
choices: to read comfortably and see clearly
interactions.answer: to read comfortably and see clearly
interactions.feedback: Posture patrol complete! You know why reading position matters.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the benefit for both your body and your eyes.
